name: alert
title: Alert
description: An inline message that draws attention without interrupting the task, with optional actions and a dismiss button.

files.content: export { Alert, type AlertProps, type AlertSize, type AlertVariant } from './Alert'

examples.name: variants
examples.title: Variants
examples.code:
import { Alert, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function AlertVariants() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="3" width="100%">
      <Alert>
        <Alert.Title>Heads up</Alert.Title>
        <Alert.Description>You can add components using the CLI.</Alert.Description>
      </Alert>
      <Alert variant="info">
        <Alert.Title>Scheduled maintenance</Alert.Title>
        <Alert.Description>Sunday 02:00–03:00 UTC.</Alert.Description>
      </Alert>
      <Alert variant="success">
        <Alert.Title>Payment received</Alert.Title>
      </Alert>
      <Alert variant="warning">
        <Alert.Title>Storage almost full</Alert.Title>
        <Alert.Description>You have used 92% of your quota.</Alert.Description>
      </Alert>
      <Alert variant="error">
        <Alert.Title>Build failed</Alert.Title>
        <Alert.Description>Check the logs for details.</Alert.Description>
      </Alert>
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <Alert.Title>This deletes the project</Alert.Title>
        <Alert.Description>Its files and history cannot be recovered.</Alert.Description>
      </Alert>
    </VStack>
  )
}

examples.name: sizes
examples.title: Sizes
examples.code:
import { Alert, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function AlertSizes() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="3" width="100%">
      <Alert
        size="sm"
        variant="info"
        title="Small"
        description="For forms, tables and other dense layouts."
      />
      <Alert variant="info" title="Medium" description="The default, for most pages." />
      <Alert
        size="lg"
        variant="info"
        title="Large"
        description="For the one message a page is about."
      />
    </VStack>
  )
}

examples.name: custom
examples.title: Custom icon, colors and radius
examples.code:
import { Alert, VStack } from '@advui/core'
import { StarIcon, TrendingUpIcon } from '@advui/icons'

export default function AlertCustom() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="3" width="100%">
      <Alert
        icon={<StarIcon />}
        title="New: shared workspaces"
        description="Invite your team and work on the same projects."
        backgroundColor="primary"
        borderColor="primary"
        color="primaryForeground"
        borderRadius="xl"
      />
      <Alert
        size="sm"
        backgroundColor="muted"
        borderWidth={0}
        icon={<TrendingUpIcon />}
        title="Tip"
        description="Sort by the last column to see this week's growth."
      />
    </VStack>
  )
}

examples.name: composition
examples.title: Composition
examples.code:
import { Alert, Text, VStack } from '@advui/core'
import { PackageIcon } from '@advui/icons'

export default function AlertComposition() {
  return (
    <Alert variant="info" icon={<PackageIcon />} width="100%">
      <Alert.Title>Before you upgrade</Alert.Title>
      <VStack gap="1">
        <Alert.Description>1. Back up the database.</Alert.Description>
        <Alert.Description>2. Read the migration guide.</Alert.Description>
        <Alert.Description>3. Update every package at once.</Alert.Description>
      </VStack>
      <Text size="xs" tone="info">
        Takes about ten minutes.
      </Text>
    </Alert>
  )
}
